changed.headline: Because of a generative AI assistant that drafts issue diagnoses and solutions, new Taobao after-sales agents randomly given access cut issue-identification time by 8.2% and raised customer ratings, with no change in customer retrials.

Because of two generative AI copilots drafting answers for its contact-centre agents, BBVA says average handling time for the most common customer enquiries in Italy and Germany fell by more than 15%.
Because of an AI coding assistant, software developers randomly given access at Microsoft, Accenture and a Fortune 100 company completed 26.08% more tasks, with a wide margin of error.

Because of a custom AI patent-drafting assistant, 133 practising patent lawyers randomly given access produced drafting work scored 0.38 SD higher at 90 days, and senior lawyers kept an advantage when redlining without AI.

A GPT-4 business assistant on WhatsApp, randomly offered to Kenyan small-business owners, had no detectable average effect on revenues or profits; high performers gained about 15% and low performers did about 8% worse.

Because of a generative AI assistant built into email, meetings and writing apps, randomly selected knowledge workers at 66 firms spent about 1.4 fewer hours a week in email sessions in months 4 to 6, a 12% decline.

Because of an AI assistant that answered routine customer emails, Octopus Energy says its trial reached a 76% customer satisfaction score against 72% for comparable human responses, on about 8,000 emails a week.

Because of an AI voice agent that takes home-care cancellation calls, Uniting NSW.ACT says about half of roughly 500 first-week interactions were handled completely by AI, at a handle time of three to three-and-a-half minutes with no queue.

Because Cleveland Clinic ran Dyania Health's Synapsis AI over its records, seven patients were enrolled in a phase 3 ATTR-CM heart trial through AI-assisted screening, taking the site past its 16-patient goal.
Because Cleveland Clinic deployed Dyania Health's Synapsis AI across the system, it says study teams have on average enrolled 40% more patients 47% faster.

Because Insilico designed ISM6331 with generative chemistry software, four of 22 evaluable previously treated mesothelioma patients had partial responses in the first human data, reported at ESMO 2026.

Because Recursion's AI screen pointed a shelved Takeda drug at familial adenomatous polyposis, 12 evaluable patients in the open-label TUPELO trial had a median 43% reduction in total polyp burden after 12 weeks.

In a 71-patient randomized placebo-controlled phase 2a trial of a drug whose target and molecule were both found with generative AI, lung function (FVC) rose +98.4 ml on 60 mg rentosertib against −20.3 ml on placebo over 12 weeks.
AI-assisted colonoscopy (GI Genius) did not significantly raise incremental adenoma detection in Lynch syndrome (33.3% vs 11.1%) in a randomized tandem trial of 100 patients.
Brief AI-assisted nerve-tracking training did not significantly improve first-attempt independent median-nerve identification (65.8% vs 57.5%) among 80 ultrasound novices.
